2._section_summary: Abstract of a single study reporting that self-compassion buffered the negative relationships between two body-related threats (body comparison and appearance-contingent self-worth) and body appreciation. The study used an online sample of 263 women (Mage = 35.26, SD = 12.42) and found that when self-compassion was high these threats were unrelated to body appreciation, whereas when self-compassion was low the relationships were strong.
